whatChanged: NEW: Uber's $14.8bn business combination agreement to acquire Delivery Hero, extending its platform to 99 markets (uber-deliveryhero-acquisition)
NEW: Stripe and Advent International's unsolicited $53bn+ ($60.50/share) takeover offer for PayPal; board meets as soon as July 20 (pypl-stripe-advent-takeover-bid)
NEW: 3M and Microsoft announce a strategic partnership on AI data-center optical infrastructure and enterprise AI transformation (mmm-msft-ai-datacenter-partnership)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: PE- and shareholder-led buyouts keep pulling listed names private: EasyJet's take-private is a live Castlelake vs Apollo bidding war (ezj-castlelake-takeover, ezj-apollo-takeover), Steel Partners is bidding $16.75/share for InMode (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), EQT/Advent/KKR are circling Qiagen (qgen-pe-consortium-takeover-interest), Vista Equity Partners and Quinti Capital have approached Criteo (crto-vista-quinti-takeover-interest), Perfect Corp.'s founder took the company private (perf-projectny-going-private), EQT keeps sweetening its Perpetual bid — now A$22.07/share (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid), Frasers Group's largest-shareholder-led hostile tender for Hugo Boss (boss-frasers-takeover-offer), and now Stripe and Advent's joint $53bn+ offer for PayPal (pypl-stripe-advent-takeover-bid) brings a major US fintech into the same wave.

themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: EasyJet's take-private is now a two-bidder contest between Castlelake (ezj-castlelake-takeover) and Apollo (ezj-apollo-takeover), ITV sold its broadcast arm to Comcast's Sky (itv-sky-me-sale), and Segro's board is fending off Prologis's unsolicited approach (pld-sgro-takeover-bid) — UK-listed names remain a magnet for control-changing bids.

themes.label: Defense primes racing for undersea/anti-submarine-warfare tech
themes.note: Defense primes keep building out undersea-warfare capability: Thales's control deal for mine-clearing drone maker Exail (ho-exail-acquisition), Lockheed's $3.45bn purchase of sonar specialist Ultra Maritime (lmt-ultra-maritime-acquisition), and Fincantieri bundling four acquisitions into an underwater-tech champion (fct-underwater-champion-acquisitions).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep drawing legal fire: the already-signed, DOJ-cleared Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger faces two separate lawsuits, from a 12-state AG coalition and from the Writers Guild of America (psky-wbd-acquisition), while an Israeli court has frozen InMode's board from deciding between competing buyout bids pending a hearing (inmd-steel-partners-buyout).

themes.label: AI data-center capacity and power build-out
themes.note: Capital and commercial partnerships keep pouring into the physical layer of AI compute: TeraWulf's 20-year, ~$19bn AI data-center lease with Anthropic (wulf-anthropic-lease), Meta's expansion of its Louisiana campus to 5GW and $50bn+ (meta-richland-parish-capex), Williams's $5.34bn Blackstone-led JV to fund five behind-the-meter data-center power projects (wmb-blackstone-power-jv), and now 3M and Microsoft's partnership to deploy 3M's optical technology across Azure's AI data centers (mmm-msft-ai-datacenter-partnership).
